items.frank_statement: External effects must remain outside model authority and require explicit valid capability/commit evidence.
items.counterhypothesis: Ubuntu process isolation, ordinary ACLs and narrow host APIs are sufficient; a language-level capability token/witness layer adds complexity without material safety benefit.
items.falsifier: Matched ClayCode application/Harness tests show no security/recovery advantage from explicit capability semantics or show unacceptable overhead/semantic friction relative to simpler host isolation.
